task: Core #1186 U10A2-F6-U01: source-only corrected Alap customer/Pro internal Office SQL and immutable baseline 0058, no quality-infrastructure changes

assuranceCeiling.rationale: Critical security correction: old 20261010093000 strict Pro v1 SQL blanket subscription check and restrictive policy deny Alap customer Office even with accepted normalized Alap officeCommunication/support grants. Need new canonical forward-only v2 SQL, fail-closed browser RLS on customer vs internal, read-only deployment readiness and falsifiable source supersession. Live PG proof remains blocked.

acceptanceCriteria: Create new forward-only canonical Office v2 SQL source with explicit supersession of unsafe historical 20261010093000 strict Pro v1; do not mutate historical SQL.

New SQL preserves source-priority and instance-specific active entitlement resolution, but caps Pro-only teamChat, secure attachments and advanced customer Office features at actual subscription_plan=pro, including platform/manual/trial overrides.

Customer thread reads use effective officeCommunication and per-instance can_manage_support for Alap and Pro; internal private/group require actual Pro plan, effective teamChat, active participant and evaluate_store_capability permission.

Browser SELECT permissive RLS remains current-user participant-aware and independent RESTRICTIVE RLS policies are per-row type: customer plan entitlement for customer threads, Pro plus Team Chat for internal threads, and customer baseline for unlinked tasks; other permissive policies cannot bypass eligibility.

Never expose actor-parameterized public.can_read_office_thread_v1 to authenticated/anon; authenticated only calls specific private current-user helper and plan-scoped private policy helpers. No broad UPDATE/INSERT/DELETE GRANT.
Copy corrected canonical v2 source bytes with SHA256 identity as customer baseline 0058; mark old strict Pro v1 as superseded source and forbid direct or renamed replay of unsafe blanket RLS.
Regression proof rejects Alap external customer denial, Alap internal chat grants, Pro unauthorized reads, wrong-tenant and stale provider/manual feature overrides and unsafe old SQL payload.
Baseline 59 files and 11 corrected active source dependencies are source-present-unproven, never hosted database release-ready, with no Supabase/production writes.

U01 deliberately leaves source-checker and read-only readiness scripts untouched; both require separately verified U02 due Critical Release Risk 7/5 decomposition. No Source Present or Fresh Install ready claim.

alternatives.summary: Add corrected forward-only Office SQL v2 source, supersede immutable unsafe Pro-v1, use type-aware restrictive RLS plus source/readiness negative proof.
alternatives.reason: Preserves versioned authority, accepted Alap support contract and original source immutability, while blocking unsafe data-plane deployments.

specialistReviews.finding: Broad restrictive Pro SQL denies Alap customer communication and reverse OR policy additions could reintroduce tenant/user disclosure.
specialistReviews.resolution: Use row-type-specific restrictive policies AND original signed-in current-user permissive RLS. Keep actor-parameterized RPC service_role-only and Pro cap internal/advanced features regardless of override.

specialistReviews.finding: Customer and internal conversation types share Office tables, while tasks can lack thread, requiring context-aware plan predicate and independent RBAC.
specialistReviews.resolution: Protect thread/messages by thread type and tasks through linked thread or basic customer entitlement in restrictive plan helper; retain store permission in permissive null-task policy.

specialistReviews.finding: Readiness checker currently requires two intentionally superseded hard-coded plan-sync migrations and blanket Pro subscriptions.
specialistReviews.resolution: Move required source list to canonical v2, update snapshots to verify corrected restrictions and block old global Pro; never claim real role/RLS proof via metadata alone.

specialistReviews.finding: Static v2 source/metadata semantics cannot prove real PostgreSQL EXECUTE grants, plan changes, tenant isolation or Fresh Install dependency ordering.
specialistReviews.resolution: Manifest remains snapshot-reviewed with explicit no-hosted-proof and parent issue OPEN; only source-level CI and negative check accepted until disposable PostgreSQL replay.

challenge.scenario: Alap store owner with can_manage_support opens their own customer support thread.
challenge.finding: Old unconditional v1 Pro check and restrictive policies incorrectly deny accepted Alap support.
challenge.resolution: Allow customer rows through effective officeCommunication and signed-in can_manage_support, and type-aware restrictive RLS rather than global Pro-only policy.

challenge.scenario: Alap tenant has active manual/platform teamChat entitlement override and attempts internal private read.
challenge.finding: Higher-priority entitlements could bypass missing Pro subscription cap.
challenge.resolution: Enforce physical subscription_plan='pro' for teamChat and advanced Office before source-priority resolution, in both service helper and restrictive RLS.

challenge.scenario: Pro user has teamChat entitlement and tries to read an internal thread they are not participant in.
challenge.finding: Plan-only RLS accepts user not authorized by conversation membership.
challenge.resolution: Preserve signed-in current-user permissive policy calling can_read_office_thread_v1 and explicit active participant + capability in helper.

challenge.scenario: A browser sends another p_user_id to public SECURITY DEFINER read helper.
challenge.finding: Actor-ID forgery can reveal other user's private thread existence.
challenge.resolution: Retain REVOKE from anon/authenticated and only allow signed-in private.current_user_can_read_office_thread_v1 to authenticated.

challenge.scenario: Old blanket restrictive Pro policy remains alongside new plan-scoped policy.
challenge.finding: PostgreSQL RESTRICTIVE policies AND; old policy still denies Alap even if corrected policy is valid.
challenge.resolution: DROP historical strict pro policies for all three Office tables before installing per-type restrictive policies.

challenge.scenario: Unlinked Office task has no conversation type or thread id.
challenge.finding: Thread helper cannot authorize; overly broad null-task OR can expose records across tenants.
challenge.resolution: Null-task restrictive predicate allows only effective basic customer entitlement; original permissive policy must still enforce can_manage_support(instance_id,auth.uid()).

challenge.scenario: Old final 20261010093000 strict Pro SQL is copied with renamed baseline source filename.
challenge.finding: Source-only parity could appear complete while Alap loses customer access.
challenge.resolution: Mark exact source superseded and reject both provenance identity and recognizable global-Pro policy body in new customer migrations.

challenge.scenario: Catalog snapshot lists helper names and corrected policies but SQL definitions still implement old Pro-only behavior.
challenge.finding: Metadata-only false positive makes deployment look safer than it is.
challenge.resolution: Read-only catalog collects function definitions; checker requires explicit customer/basic and internal/Pro separation, old global Pro policies absent, and remains non-authoritative REVIEW at best.

challenge.scenario: Migration passes source CI but true database replay fails due dependencies beyond 11 Office sources.
challenge.finding: Completion Truth overclaims if SQL source hashes are mistaken for actual PostgreSQL DDL/RLS proof.
challenge.resolution: Keep Fresh Install proofRequired and null hash, no merge or hosted database changes, reserve separate isolated actor/tenant/plan mutation test.
